title: REPORT on the implementation and delivery of the Sustainable Development Goals in view of the 2026 High-Level Political Forum
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘as a fundamental human right’, ‘by 2030, access for all to’, ‘sustainable, energy-efficient’ and ‘and combating abusive financialisation practices and speculative purchases’
part_context: Recognises the right to a place to live in peace, security and dignity, <del>as a fundamental human right</del>, and notes that the housing affordability crisis affects up to three billion people worldwide; stresses the need to ensure, by 2030, access for all to decent, suitable, safe, accessible, sustainable, energy-efficient and affordable housing and basic services, including through promoting public housing policies and combating abusive financialisation practices and speculative purchases; calls for the EU to support partner countries in developing social housing policies;
